newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's 1,022-day UDI bonds real return 6.17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's 1,022-day UDI bonds real return 6.17 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 1,022-day UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 100.85291 UDIs and a real return of 6.17 percent at the primary auction on Tuesday.
Two weeks ago the 1,036-day UDI bonds had a real return of 6.00 percent.
Demand this week was 1.897 billion UDIs compared to 350 million for the 1,022-day UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico.
The 1,750-day UDIs were assigned at a price of 101.32507 UDIs and a real return of 6.18 percent.
Two weeks ago the 1,764-day UDI bonds had a real return of 6.04 percent.
Demand this week was 1.708 billion UDIs compared to 350 million 1,750-day UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico.
The daily value of the UDI can be found on MEX14.
